outreach_drafts.body:
Dear Biscayne Harbor Family Foundation,

Thank you for your partnership and support of The Miami Foundation. We’re grateful to have you alongside us.

Here’s an update on local progress and our work. During Florida's 2021 legislative session, Senator Ileana Garcia and State Representative Nick Duran led a successful bipartisan effort to create the Biscayne Bay specialty license plate, with plate-sale revenue designated to preserve and restore Biscayne Bay.

More recently, Press Forward South Florida, an initiative fueled in part by The Miami Foundation, announced grants to more than a dozen newsrooms and partnerships serving Broward, Miami-Dade and Monroe counties. From preserving the Bay to supporting local news, there’s much to discuss about Miami’s future.

With Give Miami Day ahead, would you join our philanthropy team for a call or coffee about your year-end giving? We’d welcome a personal conversation about what matters most to you.

Everyone has a role to play. Thank you for yours.

Warmly,
The Miami Foundation’s Philanthropy Team
